### The problem

i had issues with my unifi integration (so connection to UDM Pro). Started to recreate the integration and encountered issues with the config flow

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.6.7

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Unifi Network

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/unifi/

### Diagnostics information

UniFi OS UDM Pro 1.11.4
https://community.ui.com/releases/UniFi-Network-Application-7-1-66/cf1208d2-3898-418c-b841-699e7b773fd4

It showes some change on the API as far as I understand?
